what: AI_LEGAL_ISSUE_RADAR: does artificial intelligence appear as a SUBJECT of Saudi commercial litigation in this corpus?

exclusions: named institution whose title contains an AI term (SDAIA and the like)
AI as an advertised attribute of goods, which is L2 and never L3
method.firstPassCorrection: the first pass returned 2 L3 judgments. Both were read and both were false positives: one names the Saudi Data and AI Authority as proof that a trademark is well known, the other describes a device sold as AI-powered. Two exclusion rules were added and the pass re-run. No judgment was reclassified by hand.
method.noStylometry: nothing here infers that a document was produced with AI. Only what a judgment DISCUSSES is measured.
method.recall: bounded by the inventory. A dispute about an algorithmic system that never names one is invisible, so every count is a floor.
